pricing.simpleTransparentPricingDescription: Koordinate is designed to grow with your business. Our flexible plans ensure you only pay for what you need, with clear, predictable costs.
pricing.faq1Q: How is the monthly cost calculated?
pricing.faq1A: Our pricing consists of a base fee of {{baseFee}}€ per month, plus an additional {{perWorkerFee}}€ for each active worker.
pricing.faq2A: No, our pricing is completely transparent. The monthly base fee and per-worker cost are the only charges.
pricing.faq3Q: Can I add or remove workers at any time?
pricing.faq3A: Yes, you can adjust your worker count as needed. Your billing will be prorated accordingly.
pricing.faq4Q: Is there a contract or a minimum commitment period?
pricing.faq4A: No, there are no long-term contracts. You can cancel your subscription at any time.
pricing.faq5Q: What happens if I add more workers?
pricing.faq5A: Extra seats are prorated. You only pay for the remaining days of the billing cycle.
pricing.faq6A: Yes, each worker needs an account to access assignments and track hours.

index.heroTitle:
Your crew.
Your sites.
Under control.
index.heroSub: Koordinate gives field managers a live view of every worker and every job site — with automatic time tracking, smart scheduling, and one-click payroll.
index.featuresSub: No integrations. No stitching together four apps. Scheduling, tracking, and payroll — end to end.
index.cardSchedulingDesc: Drag workers onto job sites each morning. They see the assignment instantly in their app — no WhatsApp groups, no confusion.
index.cardLiveMapDesc: See every worker in real time. Know who is on-site and who hasn't arrived.
index.cardTimeTrackingDesc: Sessions start at check-in, close at checkout. Hours log themselves.
index.cardPayrollDesc: Pull a formatted export at month end. Hours already calculated per worker and project.
index.cardReplayDesc: Rewind any worker's full day on the map. Resolve disputes and verify presence with a timeline slider.
index.step01Desc: Create your account, add projects and locations. Takes under 5 minutes.
index.step02Desc: Send an invite link or code. Workers download the app and are ready.
index.step03Desc: Drag workers onto assignments each morning. They see it instantly.
index.step04Desc: Live map, live sessions, full visibility without lifting the phone.
index.ctaTitle: Ready to get your crew organised?
index.ctaSub: Join construction companies using Koordinate to run cleaner, faster field operations.

privacy.title: Location & Privacy
privacy.intro: Before you start, here is how Koordinate uses your data.
privacy.locationBody: The app collects your GPS location in the background while you are checked in to a work session. Tracking stops automatically when you check out. Location data is only visible to your employer.
privacy.dataBody: Work session start and end times, GPS location events during active sessions, and your profile information (name, email).
privacy.retentionBody: GPS data is deleted after 90 days. Work hour records are kept for up to 10 years for payroll compliance.
privacy.rightsBody: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting your employer or Koordinate at info@koordinate.app.
privacy.poweredBy: Your data is processed by Koordinate under GDPR.
